mintAuthority.summary: XAUm MToken minting is operator- or receipt-NFT-controlled and budget-limited by reserve/mint-budget accounting; the owner can change the operator. Ethereum and Sui State controls confirmed: owner EOA and operator verified on both chains.

controls.label: XAUm MToken operator mint path
controls.capDescription: mintTo is limited by mintBudget, observed as zero at Ethereum block 26095797. MTokenMain.increaseMintBudget is callable by the operator and checks usedReserve against the configured reserve feed. The owner can replace the operator or feeds through the delayed administration path.

controls.label: XAUm receipt NFT mint path
controls.capDescription: mintTo is callable by the operator or configured nftContract, subject to the same mintBudget and delayed request. nftContract() at Ethereum block 26095797 returned this receipt NFT. The operator can increase the native mint budget subject to reserve-feed checks; the owner can replace operator, feeds and implementation through delayed paths.
controls.evidence: The verified MToken mintTo path permits calls from the configured NFT contract as well as the operator, subject to the same mintBudget accounting.

controls.label: Matrixdock token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295020: eth_getCode on 0xb573c94260582f0715FC477928B04A2708dd36D7 returned 0x (EOA confirmed). This EOA controls setOperator() and reserve accounting. Same address owns both XAGm and XAUm MToken contracts.

controls.label: XAUm Soroban operator and budget administrator

sources.label: Contract instance and account state at one ledger

controls.evidence: Single getLedgerEntries response at ledger 64756409 binds current WASM 2f91a70d1a90673e280644e0489923858d135dab330fb5ef8e32e64029ecabdd and operator/revoker GBH4OGIIVUICGD6NNUNE27OWRMGCEUOJAGSD6M7H5MLBHWP23BUXILN4. Its account thresholds bytes are 01000000 with no additional signers: one active master key. Source-verified change_mint_budget requires operator authorization and can increase the budget without a collateral transfer or reserve oracle check. mint_to spends that mutable budget after the observed 14400-second delay. Budget zero is not absence of issuance power. No human/key-custody independence is asserted.
